nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Defines the guarded OpenSpec archival procedure, including status checks, incomplete-task warnings, delta-spec synchronization assessment, and dated relocation. / 定义受约束的 OpenSpec 归档流程，包括状态检查、未完成任务警告、delta spec 同步评估以及按日期迁移目录。

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Defines a read-only, code-grounded exploration stance for clarifying requirements, comparing options, visualizing systems, and optionally capturing decisions in OpenSpec artifacts. / 定义一种只读且以代码为依据的探索方式，用于澄清需求、比较方案、可视化系统，并可选择将决策记录到 OpenSpec 工件中。

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Defines a one-step OpenSpec proposal workflow that creates a change, follows artifact dependency order, and produces every artifact required before implementation. / 定义一步式 OpenSpec 提案工作流：创建变更、按工件依赖顺序推进，并生成实施前所需的全部工件。

nodes.name: c4d-cpp-style-guide.mdc
nodes.summary: Defines Cursor guidance for Cinema 4D C++20 code, covering Maxon-specific types and APIs, naming, formatting, class design, error handling, and threading constraints. / 定义面向 Cinema 4D C++20 代码的 Cursor 指南，涵盖 Maxon 专用类型与 API、命名、格式、类设计、错误处理和线程约束。

nodes.name: project-structure.mdc
nodes.summary: Documents the repository layout, supported Cinema 4D SDK wrappers, dependency ownership, shared CMake modules, build commands, junction-based source sharing, and include conventions. / 记录仓库布局、受支持的 Cinema 4D SDK 包装层、依赖归属、共享 CMake 模块、构建命令、基于 junction 的源码共享及 include 约定。

nodes.name: .cursorignore
nodes.summary: Excludes generated CMake outputs, build trees, IDE metadata, and object directories from Cursor indexing. / 将生成的 CMake 输出、构建目录、IDE 元数据和对象目录排除在 Cursor 索引之外。

nodes.name: .gitattributes
nodes.summary: Overrides GitHub Linguist classification so Python and header files are counted as C++. / 覆盖 GitHub Linguist 分类规则，使 Python 文件和头文件按 C++ 统计。

nodes.name: .gitmodules
nodes.summary: Registers Bullet3, libMMD, and the installer setup as Git submodules with their repository paths and upstream URLs. / 将 Bullet3、libMMD 和安装程序 setup 注册为 Git submodule，并记录其仓库路径与上游 URL。

nodes.name: dev.example.cmake
nodes.summary: Provides a portable Debug-oriented initial cache example targeting sdk_2026, with optional libMMD tests and no packaging tool registration. / 提供面向 sdk_2026 的可移植 Debug 初始缓存示例，可选启用 libMMD 测试且不注册打包工具。

nodes.name: package.example.cmake
nodes.summary: Provides a Release packaging initial cache for sdk_2026, including an editable Inno Setup compiler path and optional version arguments. / 提供面向 sdk_2026 的 Release 打包初始缓存，其中包含可编辑的 Inno Setup 编译器路径和可选版本参数。

nodes.name: mmdtool_plugin_common.cmake
nodes.summary: Centralizes shared Cinema 4D plugin setup across SDK wrappers: dependency modes, source and resource junctions, Maxon target variables, platform-specific includes and linking, and third-party attachment. / 集中管理各 SDK 包装层共享的 Cinema 4D 插件配置，包括依赖模式、源码与资源 junction、Maxon target 变量、平台专用 include 与链接，以及第三方库接入。

nodes.name: cmt_collect_dependency_libs
nodes.summary: Scans installed .lib and .a artifacts, separates debug from release variants, sorts them, and returns four platform-specific library lists to the caller. / 扫描已安装的 .lib 与 .a 产物，区分 Debug 和 Release 变体、执行排序，并向调用方返回四组平台专用库列表。

nodes.name: _cmt_link_subdir_third_party_to_plugin
nodes.summary: Links libMMD and Bullet CMake targets privately into the plugin after Maxon target processing when subdirectory targets are present. / 当 subdirectory target 存在时，在 Maxon target 处理完成后将 libMMD 与 Bullet CMake target 私有链接到插件。

nodes.name: cmt_setup_mmdtool_plugin
nodes.summary: Parses shared plugin parameters, selects SUBDIR, INSTALL, or PREBUILT dependency behavior, creates source and resource junctions, configures Maxon targets per platform, and finalizes linking and debugger settings. / 解析共享插件参数，选择 SUBDIR、INSTALL 或 PREBUILT 依赖模式，创建源码与资源 junction，按平台配置 Maxon target，并完成链接和调试器设置。

nodes.name: mmdtool_plugin_dependencies.cmake
nodes.summary: Adds Bullet3 and libMMD to the SDK build graph unless prebuilt libraries are selected, validating source roots and forcing compatible static-build and test options. / 在未选择预构建库时将 Bullet3 与 libMMD 加入 SDK 构建图，同时验证源码根目录并强制使用兼容的静态构建与测试选项。

nodes.name: mmdtool_plugin_dependencies_add
nodes.summary: Validates configurable Bullet3 and libMMD source roots, applies ABI-compatible static-build options, and adds both dependencies under per-build cmt_deps directories unless prebuilt artifacts are selected. / 验证可配置的 Bullet3 与 libMMD 源码根目录，应用 ABI 兼容的静态构建选项，并在未选择预构建产物时将两项依赖加入各构建目录下的 cmt_deps。

nodes.name: compile_definitions.cmake
nodes.summary: Defines guarded Maxon target macros for 64-bit, Debug, Release, and Windows builds, including Unicode and platform compatibility flags. / 定义带 include guard 的 Maxon target 宏，覆盖 64 位、Debug、Release 和 Windows 构建，并包含 Unicode 与平台兼容标志。

nodes.name: compile_options.cmake
nodes.summary: Defines guarded compiler and ISA option sets for MSVC, ClangCL, Clang, GCC, Objective-C, and platform-specific Debug and Release builds. / 定义带 include guard 的编译器与 ISA 选项集，覆盖 MSVC、ClangCL、Clang、GCC、Objective-C 以及各平台的 Debug 与 Release 构建。

nodes.name: link_options.cmake
nodes.summary: Defines guarded linker flags for ClangCL with MSVC semantics and Linux Clang or GCC, while retaining full debug information in Release builds. / 定义带 include guard 的 ClangCL/MSVC 语义与 Linux Clang/GCC 链接选项，并在 Release 构建中保留完整调试信息。

nodes.name: sanitize.cmake
nodes.summary: Defines guarded AddressSanitizer compile definitions and link options for supported Release configurations. / 为受支持的 Release 配置定义带 include guard 的 AddressSanitizer 编译定义与链接选项。
